headline: Full-time work leads at 83.3 %, and no one reports seeking work.
how_to_read: Left: all respondents; middle: employed versus not employed; right: the detailed situation. Band widths show each group's share of respondents. The hatched 'Hidden' flow marks groups with fewer than 3 people, whose values are not shown.
key_findings: Full-time employment is 83.3 %; no one reports other employment.
Seeking work, not seeking work, studying and retirement are all 0.0 %.
Total employment, total not employed, part-time, self-employment and other situation are hidden (fewer than 3 people).
benchmark: Full-time work is 9.1 pp above the European region (74.2 %) and 8.4 pp above all schools (74.9 %). Seeking work at 0.0 % compares with 3.5 % in the region and 4.3 % across all schools.
caveats: At n = 30 each person shifts percentages by several points, and the headline totals are hidden.
